translations.literal: When the army returned, he died at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he died at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: ○孟德

translations.literal: ○ Mengde
translations.idiomatic: Mengde

sentences.zh: 子智襲職，授三珠虎符、宣武將軍，為萬戶。

translations.literal: His son Zhi inherited the office, was granted a three-pearl tiger tally and the title General of Martial Proclamation, and was made commander of ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhi succeeded to the command, received a triple-pearl tiger tally and the title General of Martial Proclamation, and was made a commander of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 延祐二年，進明威將軍，以病去職。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou he was promoted to General of Illustrious Might and resigned because of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yanyou he was promoted to General of Illustrious Might, but illness forced him to relinquish his post.

sentences.zh: 子安世襲。

translations.literal: His son Anshi inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Anshi succeeded him.

sentences.zh: ○鄭義

translations.literal: ○ Zheng Yi
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yi

sentences.zh: 鄭義，河間人也。

translations.literal: Zheng Yi was a man of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yi was a native of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 初，事太宗，佩金符，山東路都元帥，兼景州軍民人匠長官。

translations.literal: At first he served Taizong, wore a golden tally, served as commander-in-chief of Shandong Circuit, and concurrently as chief administrator of the military, civilian, and artisan populations of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He first served under Taizong, bearing a golden tally as commander-in-chief of Shandong Circuit and concurrent chief administrator of Jingzhou's military, civilian, and artisan populations.

sentences.zh: 從伐金，歲壬辰，與敵戰於歸德，死之。

translations.literal: On the campaign against the Jin, in the year renchen he fought the enemy at Guide and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the campaign against the Jin, in the year renchen he fought the enemy at Guide and fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 弟德溫襲。

translations.literal: His younger brother Dewen inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Dewen succeeded to the post.

sentences.zh: 甲午，從攻徐州，陷陣而死。

translations.literal: In the year jiawu he joined the attack on Xuzhou and died breaking through the enemy lines.
translations.idiomatic: In the year jiawu he joined the assault on Xuzhou and was killed in the heat of battle.

sentences.zh: 子澤襲。

translations.literal: His son Ze inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ze inherited the command.

sentences.zh: 從萬戶史天澤出征，多立戰功。

translations.literal: Campaigning under the commander of ten thousand households Shi Tianze, he won many martial achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning under the ten-thousand-household commander Shi Tianze, he won many victories.

sentences.zh: 年老，弟江代其職。

translations.literal: When he grew old, his younger brother Jiang replaced him in office.
translations.idiomatic: When age overtook him, his younger brother Jiang took over his command.

sentences.zh: 世祖北征，賜金符，授侍衛親軍副都指揮使，判武衛軍事，兼景州軍民人匠長官。

translations.literal: During Shizu's northern expedition he was granted a golden tally, appointed vice commander of the personal guard, given authority over Military Guard affairs, and concurrently made chief administrator of the military, civilian, and artisan populations of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During Shizu's northern expedition he was granted a golden tally and appointed vice commander of the personal guard, with authority over Military Guard affairs and concurrent charge of Jingzhou's military, civilian, and artisan populations.

sentences.zh: 中統三年，李璮據濟南叛，世祖令各州縣長官子弟充千戶，於是以江子郇為千戶，領景州新簽軍千餘，敗賊眾於王馬橋，諸王哈必赤賞銀五十兩。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong, Li Tan rebelled and held Jinan. Shizu ordered the sons of district officials to serve as commanders of a thousand households. Jiang's son Xun was thus made a thousand-household commander, led more than a thousand newly conscripted troops from Jingzhou, and defeated the rebels at Wangma Bridge. Prince Qabochi rewarded him with fifty taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhongtong, when Li Tan rebelled and seized Jinan, Shizu required the sons of district officials to serve as commanders of a thousand households. Jiang's son Xun was thus appointed commander, led more than a thousand newly conscripted troops from Jingzhou, and routed the rebels at Wangma Bridge; Prince Qabochi rewarded him with fifty taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 璮平，郇以例罷。

translations.literal: When Tan was pacified, Xun was dismissed according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Tan's rebellion was crushed, Xun was relieved of command according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 江升為武衛親軍都指揮使，賜虎符，尋改屬左衛。

translations.literal: Jiang was promoted to commander of the Military Guard personal troops and granted a tiger tally; soon afterward he was transferred to the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang was promoted to commander of the Military Guard and granted a tiger tally; shortly afterward his command was transferred to the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，從攻襄陽，歿於陣，郇襲其職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan he joined the attack on Xiangyang and died in battle. Xun inherited his office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan he joined the siege of Xiangyang and fell on the battlefield; Xun succeeded to his command.

sentences.zh: ○張榮實

translations.literal: ○ Zhang Rongshi
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Rongshi

sentences.zh: 張榮實，霸州保定縣人。

translations.literal: Zhang Rongshi was a man of Baoding County in Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Rongshi was a native of Baoding County in Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 父進，金季封北平公，守信安城。

translations.literal: His father Jin was enfeoffed Duke of Northern Peace in the late Jin period and held Xin'an city.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jin was enfeoffed Duke of Northern Peace in the dying days of the Jin and held the city of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 壬辰歲，率所部兵民降，太宗命為徵行萬戶。

translations.literal: In the year renchen he led his troops and people to surrender. Taizong appointed him campaign commander of ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the year renchen he brought his troops and people over to surrender; Taizong appointed him campaign commander of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 甲午，徵河南，與金將國用安戰徐州，死焉。

translations.literal: In jiawu, on the campaign into Henan, he fought the Jin general Guo Yong'an at Xuzhou and died there.
translations.idiomatic: In jiawu, on the campaign into Henan, he fought the Jin general Guo Yong'an at Xuzhou and fell.

sentences.zh: 榮實始以質子入宿衛，繼授金符，充徵行水軍千戶。

translations.literal: Rongshi had first entered as a hostage to serve in the palace guard, then was granted a golden tally and appointed campaign commander of a thousand households in the navy.
translations.idiomatic: Rongshi had first come to court as a hostage in the imperial guard, then received a golden tally and was appointed commander of a thousand households in the campaign navy.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，改雄州保定新城長官。

translations.literal: In dingyou he was reassigned as chief administrator of Baoding New City in Xiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In dingyou he was reassigned as chief administrator of Baoding New City in Xiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復命統領水軍。

translations.literal: In gengzi he was again ordered to command the naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: In gengzi he was again ordered to take command of the fleet.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，從大將察罕軍至淮上，遇宋將呂文德，與戰，俘五十餘人，賞銀碗、戰馬。

translations.literal: In jiachen he followed the great general Chaghan's army to the Huai River, encountered the Song general Lü Wende, fought him, captured more than fifty men, and was rewarded with a silver bowl and a war horse.
translations.idiomatic: In jiachen he marched with the great general Chaghan to the Huai River, met the Song general Lü Wende in battle, took more than fifty prisoners, and was rewarded with a silver bowl and a war horse.

sentences.zh: 從攻江陵，略襄陽。

translations.literal: He joined the attack on Jiangling and raided Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the assault on Jiangling and raided toward Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 宋以舟師橫截漢水，兵不得渡，榮實戰卻之，獲人百餘，戰船數十艘，察罕以聞，賜錦袍及銀十五斤。

translations.literal: The Song used a fleet to block the Han River crosswise, and the army could not cross. Rongshi fought and drove them back, capturing more than a hundred men and several dozen war vessels. Chaghan reported this, and he was granted a brocade robe and fifteen jin of silver.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song fleet barred the Han River and the army could not cross, Rongshi drove them back, capturing more than a hundred men and several dozen warships. Chaghan reported his deed, and he was granted a brocade robe and fifteen jin of silver.

sentences.zh: 又破宋軍於太湖，賞銀百兩。

translations.literal: He again defeated the Song army at Lake Tai and was rewarded with a hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: He again broke the Song forces at Lake Tai and was rewarded with a hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 己未，從世祖南征，駐陽羅渡。

translations.literal: In jiwei he followed Shizu's southern campaign and encamped at the Yangluo crossing.
translations.idiomatic: In jiwei he accompanied Shizu's southern expedition and encamped at the Yangluo crossing.

sentences.zh: 宋兵十萬、舟二千迎戰，橫截江水。

translations.literal: Song troops numbered a hundred thousand with two thousand vessels came to meet them in battle and blocked the Yangtze crosswise.
translations.idiomatic: A Song force of a hundred thousand men in two thousand ships came to meet them, blocking the Yangtze head-on.

sentences.zh: 帝以榮實習於水，命居前列，遂取輕舟，率麾下水校鏖戰北岸，獲宋大船二十，俘二百，溺死不可勝計，斬宋將呂文信。

translations.literal: Because Rongshi was skilled in water warfare, the Emperor ordered him to the front ranks. He then took light boats, led his naval officers in fierce fighting along the north bank, captured twenty great Song vessels and two hundred prisoners, drowned so many that their number could not be counted, and killed the Song general Lü Wenxin.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing Rongshi's mastery of water warfare, the Emperor placed him in the vanguard. He took light craft, led his naval officers into fierce fighting along the north bank, seized twenty great Song vessels and two hundred prisoners, and drowned so many that their number were beyond counting; he also killed the Song general Lü Wenxin.

sentences.zh: 中統元年，帝即位，錄其勳勞，授金虎符、水軍萬戶，仍以其子顏代為霸州七處管民萬戶。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong, when the Emperor took the throne, he recorded Rongshi's meritorious service, granted him a golden tiger tally and the post of commander of ten thousand households in the navy, and still appointed his son Yan to succeed him as civilian commander of ten thousand households over seven districts in Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhongtong, when the Emperor took the throne, he commended Rongshi's meritorious service, granted him a golden tiger tally and the post of commander of ten thousand households in the navy, and appointed his son Yan to succeed him as civilian commander of ten thousand households over seven districts in Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，李璮叛，榮實從史天澤討平之，賞金碗及銀二百五十兩、馬一匹，命鎮膠西。

translations.literal: In the third year, Li Qian rebelled; Rongshi followed Shi Tianze to suppress and pacify him, was rewarded with a gold bowl and two hundred fifty taels of silver and one horse, and was ordered to garrison Jiaoxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhongtong, Li Qian rebelled. Rongshi marched with Shi Tianze to put down the revolt and was rewarded with a gold bowl, two hundred fifty taels of silver, and a horse, then ordered to garrison Jiaoxi.

sentences.zh: 至元五年，從丞相阿術攻襄陽，敗夏貴，擒張順；

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan, following Chancellor A Shu he attacked Xiangyang, defeated Xia Gui, and captured Zhang Shun;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan he followed Chancellor A Shu against Xiangyang, routed Xia Gui, and took Zhang Shun captive;

sentences.zh: 又攻樊城，俘其二將，賞銀百兩及弓矢鞍勒。

translations.literal: He again attacked Fancheng, captured its two generals, and was rewarded with one hundred taels of silver together with bow, arrows, saddle, and bridle.
translations.idiomatic: then pressed the attack on Fancheng, captured two of its generals, and received one hundred taels of silver along with bows, arrows, saddles, and bridles.

sentences.zh: 十一年，增領新軍，從丞相伯顏南征，榮實以所部軍先進，諸將飛渡，鄂、漢皆降，論功授昭毅大將軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was additionally put in command of new troops; following Chancellor Bayan on the southern expedition, Rongshi with his own command advanced first, the generals crossed as though flying, E and Han both surrendered, and for his merit he was appointed General of Manifest Resolution.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he took command of new troops as well and followed Chancellor Bayan south. Rongshi led his own men in the van; the other commanders crossed the river in swift succession, Ezhou and Hanchuan both submitted, and he was made a manifest-resolution general for his service.

sentences.zh: 從阿里海牙攻岳州，降宋將高世傑，破沙洋、新城，降江陵，以功加昭武大將軍。

translations.literal: Following Alihaiya he attacked Yuezhou, induced Song general Gao Shijie to surrender, broke Shayang and Xincheng, and received the surrender of Jiangling; for his merit he was further made General of Manifest Martiality.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Alihaiya against Yuezhou, won over the Song general Gao Shijie, stormed Shayang and Xincheng, and took Jiangling. For these deeds he was further promoted to manifest-martiality general.

sentences.zh: 偕元帥宋都台徵江西隆興，擒宋將密佑，撫州降。

translations.literal: Together with Marshal Songdutai he marched on Longxing in Jiangxi, captured Song general Mi You, and Fuzhou surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Marshal Songdutai he marched on Longxing in Jiangxi, captured the Song general Mi You, and Fuzhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授同知江西道宣慰使司事，未旬日，升鎮國上將軍、福建道宣慰使。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed associate commissioner of the Jiangxi Circuit Pacification Commission; within ten days he was promoted to General of Stabilizing the State and Pacification Commissioner of the Fujian Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was made associate commissioner of the Jiangxi Circuit Pacification Commission; within ten days he was raised to stabilizing-state general and pacification commissioner of the Fujian Circuit.

sentences.zh: 進兵廣東，破降韶州。

translations.literal: He advanced troops into Guangdong and broke and received the surrender of Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He pushed into Guangdong, broke Shaozhou, and received its surrender.

sentences.zh: 十四年，改江東宣慰使、行省參知政事。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was reassigned as Pacification Commissioner of Jiangdong and Associate Administrator of the Provincial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was reassigned as Jiangdong pacification commissioner and associate administrator of the provincial secretariat.

sentences.zh: 帝以廣東餘黨未附，命與右丞塔出撫定之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because remnant bands in Guangdong had not yet submitted, ordered him together with Right Chancellor Tachu to pacify and settle them.
translations.idiomatic: Because holdouts in Guangdong had not yet submitted, the Emperor ordered him and Right Chancellor Tachu to pacify the region.

sentences.zh: 十五年，入覲，帝賜酒慰勞，授湖北道宣慰使、諸路水軍萬戶。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he entered for audience; the Emperor bestowed wine to comfort and reward him and appointed him Pacification Commissioner of the Hubei Circuit and Ten-Thousand-Household of the Various Routes' Naval Forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he came to court. The Emperor gave him wine in reward and appointed him Hubei Circuit pacification commissioner and ten-thousand-household of the various routes' naval forces.

sentences.zh: 是年，以疾卒，年六十一。

translations.literal: That year he died of illness, aged sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: That year he died of illness, at the age of sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 子顏、玉、圭。

translations.literal: His sons were Yan, Yu, and Gui.
translations.idiomatic: He had three sons: Yan, Yu, and Gui.

sentences.zh: 玉襲父職，為懷遠大將軍、諸路水軍萬戶。

translations.literal: Yu inherited his father's post as General of Pacifying the Distant and Ten-Thousand-Household of the Various Routes' Naval Forces.
translations.idiomatic: Yu inherited his father's post as pacifying-the-distant general and ten-thousand-household of the various routes' naval forces.

sentences.zh: 十六年，討吉安叛賊有功，入朝，賜金織文衣、弓矢、佩刀，加輔國上將軍、都元帥、兼水軍萬戶，鎮黃州。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he suppressed rebel bandits in Ji'an with merit, entered court, and was granted gold brocade ceremonial robes, bow and arrows, and a girdle sword; he was further made General of Assisting the State, Grand Marshal, and concurrent Ten-Thousand-Household of the Naval Forces, and garrisoned Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he suppressed rebel bandits in Ji'an with merit, came to court, and was granted gold brocade robes, bow and arrows, and a girdle sword. He was further made assisting-state general and grand marshal, retained his post as naval ten-thousand-household, and garrisoned Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 繼奉旨與元帥唐兀台改立蘄黃等路都元帥府，仍管領本道鎮守軍馬。

translations.literal: He then received an edict together with Marshal Tang'utai to reorganize the Qihuang Circuit Grand Marshal's Office, and still commanded the garrison troops of his circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was then ordered, together with Marshal Tang'utai, to reorganize the Qihuang Circuit grand marshal's office, while continuing to command the garrison troops of his circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十年，廣東盜起，遏絕占城糧運。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year bandits rose in Guangdong and cut off Champa grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year pirates rose in Guangdong and cut off the grain convoys from Champa.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，玉率兵討平之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Yu led troops and suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Yu led troops and put them down.

sentences.zh: 從參知政事也​​的迷失入朝，賜金織文衣、鞍勒、弓刀。

translations.literal: Following Associate Administrator Yeshimishi to court, he was granted gold brocade ceremonial robes, saddle and bridle, and bow and blade.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Associate Administrator Yeshimishi to court and was granted gold brocade robes, saddle and bridle, and bow and blade.

sentences.zh: 會元帥罷，命玉充保定水軍上萬戶。

translations.literal: When the grand marshal's office was abolished, Yu was ordered to fill the post of upper naval ten-thousand-household of Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: When the grand marshal's office was abolished, Yu was appointed senior naval ten-thousand-household of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，番陽湖賊起，詔徙水軍萬戶府於南康。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year bandits rose at Poyang Lake; an edict moved the Naval Ten-Thousand-Household Office to Nankang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year bandits rose on Poyang Lake, and an edict moved the naval ten-thousand-household office to Nankang.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，從參知政事烏馬兒徵交趾，累戰有功。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he followed Associate Administrator Wuma'er on the campaign against Jiaozhi and repeatedly won merit in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he followed Associate Administrator Wuma'er on the campaign against Jiaozhi and won repeated battle honors.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，師還，安南以兵迎戰，大戰連日，水涸舟不能行，玉死焉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, as the army returned, Annam met them in battle; they fought great battles for days, but the water dried up and the boats could not move, and Yu died there.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, as the army withdrew, Annam met them in battle. Fighting lasted for days, but the rivers ran low and the boats could not move; Yu died there.

sentences.zh: 子輔襲萬戶。

translations.literal: His son Fu inherited the ten-thousand-household post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Fu inherited the ten-thousand-household post.

sentences.zh: 輔卒，子道重襲。

translations.literal: When Fu died, his son Daozhong inherited.
translations.idiomatic: When Fu died, his son Daozhong inherited in turn.

sentences.zh: ○石抹狗狗

translations.literal: ○ Shi Mogougou
translations.idiomatic: Shi Mogougou

sentences.zh: 石抹狗狗，契丹人，其先曰高奴。

translations.literal: Shi Mogougou was a Khitan; his ancestor was called Gaonu.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Mogougou was a Khitan. His forebear was called Gaonu.

sentences.zh: 歲辛未，太祖至威寧，高奴與劉伯林、夾谷常哥等以城降。

translations.literal: In the xinwei year, when the Founding Emperor reached Weining, Gaonu together with Liu Bolin, Jiagu Changge, and others surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the xinwei year, when the Founding Emperor reached Weining, Gaonu together with Liu Bolin, Jiagu Changge, and others surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 會置三萬戶、三十六千戶以總天下兵，遂以高奴為千戶，遙授青州防禦使，佩金符。

translations.literal: When three ten-thousand-households and thirty-six thousand-households were established to command all armies under Heaven, Gaonu was made a thousand-household, given the remote appointment of Defense Commissioner of Qingzhou, and granted a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: When the three ten-thousand-households and thirty-six thousand-households were established to command armies throughout the realm, Gaonu was made a thousand-household, given the remote appointment of defense commissioner of Qingzhou, and granted a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 己丑，從太宗伐金，為徵行千戶，卒於軍。

translations.literal: In the jichou year he followed Emperor Taizong in campaigning against Jin as an expeditionary thousand-household and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the jichou year he followed Emperor Taizong against Jin as an expeditionary thousand-household and died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 子常山，襲為千戶。

translations.literal: His son Changshan inherited as thousand-household.
translations.idiomatic: His son Changshan inherited the thousand-household post.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，升總管，領興元諸軍奧魯屯田，並寶雞驛軍，權都總管萬戶，歲餘卒。

translations.literal: In the guichou year he was promoted to commander-in-chief, put in charge of the military-colony fields of the Xingyuan armies' households together with the Baoji post-station troops, given acting status as commander-in-chief of the ten-thousand-household, and died a little over a year later.
translations.idiomatic: In the guichou year he was promoted to commander-in-chief, put in charge of the Xingyuan armies' household colonies and the Baoji post-station troops, and given acting status as commander-in-chief of the ten-thousand-household. He died a little over a year later.

sentences.zh: 子乞兒襲，領本萬戶諸翼軍馬，從都元帥紐璘攻重慶、瀘、敘諸城，數有戰功。

translations.literal: His son Qi'er inherited, commanded the wing forces of his ten-thousand-household, and following Grand Marshal Niuchin attacked the cities of Chongqing, Lu, and Xu, repeatedly winning battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: His son Qi'er inherited, took command of the wing forces under his ten-thousand-household, and followed Grand Marshal Niuchin in attacks on Chongqing, Lu, Xu, and other cities, winning battle honors again and again.

sentences.zh: 時忽都叛於臨洮，乞兒等以蒙古、漢軍從往討之。

translations.literal: At the time Hudou rebelled at Lintao; Qi'er and others with Mongol and Han armies followed to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hudou rebelled at Lintao. Qi'er and others led Mongol and Han troops to join the suppression.

sentences.zh: 至元二年，從都元帥按敦移鎮潼川。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhiyuan he followed Grand Marshal Andun in moving the garrison to Tongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhiyuan he followed Grand Marshal Andun when the garrison was moved to Tongchuan.

sentences.zh: 四年九月，從攻蓬溪寨，死焉，子狗狗襲。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year he followed the attack on Pengxi Stockade and died there; his son Mogougou inherited.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourth year he joined the assault on Pengxi Stockade and died there. His son Mogougou inherited.

sentences.zh: 狗狗少從征伐，以壯勇稱。

translations.literal: Mogougou had followed campaigns since youth and was known for bold courage.
translations.idiomatic: Mogougou had campaigned since youth and was known for bold courage.

sentences.zh: 八年，從僉省嚴忠範以兵圍重慶，攻朝陽寨，先登。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed Commissioner Yan Zhongfan in surrounding Chongqing with troops, attacked Chaoyang Stockade, and was first over the wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he followed Commissioner Yan Zhongfan in besieging Chongqing, assaulted Chaoyang Stockade, and was first over the wall.

sentences.zh: 九年，宋將昝萬壽率眾襲成都，狗狗以蒙古軍二千擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Song general Zan Wanshou led a force to raid Chengdu; Mogougou with two thousand Mongol troops defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Song general Zan Wanshou led a force in a surprise attack on Chengdu. Mogougou routed him with two thousand Mongol troops.

sentences.zh: 十六年，朝廷錄其前後功，賜金虎符，授宣武將軍、管軍總管，戍遂寧。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the court recorded his earlier and later merits, granted a gold tiger tally, and appointed him General of Manifest Martiality and Army Commander-in-Chief, garrisoning Suining.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the court reviewed his earlier and later deeds, granted him a gold tiger tally, and made him manifest-martiality general and army commander-in-chief, garrisoning Suining.

sentences.zh: 十七年，進明威將軍、管軍副萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to General of Bright Martiality and Deputy Ten-Thousand-Household of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to bright-martiality general and deputy army ten-thousand-household.

sentences.zh: 亦奚不薛蠻叛，從招討使藥剌海討平之。

translations.literal: When the Yixibuxue barbarians rebelled, he followed Pacification Commissioner Yalihai to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yixibuxue tribes rebelled, he followed Pacification Commissioner Yalihai and put them down.

sentences.zh: 行省也速帶兒討都掌、烏蒙、蟻子諸蠻，戰於鴨樓關，狗狗最有功。

translations.literal: The regional secretariat's Yesudar campaigned against the Duzhang, Wumeng, Yizi, and other barbarians; at Yalou Pass Mogougou's merit was greatest.
translations.idiomatic: When the regional secretariat's Yesudar campaigned against the Duzhang, Wumeng, Yizi, and other tribes, Mogougou won the greatest credit at Yalou Pass.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，以蒙古軍八百從征散貓蠻，戰於菜園坪、滲水溪，皆敗之，壁守石寨，月餘散貓降，大盤​​諸蠻亦降。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year with eight hundred Mongol troops he followed the campaign against the Sanmao barbarians; at Caiyuan Flat and Shensui Stream he defeated them both, walled and held Shishi Stockade, and after more than a month Sanmao surrendered and the Dapan barbarians also submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he took eight hundred Mongol troops against the Sanmao tribes, defeated them at Caiyuan Flat and Shensui Stream, then walled up and held Shishi Stockade. After more than a month Sanmao surrendered, and the Dapan tribes submitted as well.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，遷懷遠大將軍、夔路萬戶，移戍重慶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to General of Pacifying the Distant and Ten-Thousand-Household of Kuilu, moving his garrison to Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to pacifying-the-distant general and ten-thousand-household of Kuilu, and moved his garrison to Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he died.

sentences.zh: 子安童襲。

translations.literal: His son Antong inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Antong inherited.

sentences.zh: ○楚鼎

translations.literal: ○ Chu Ding
translations.idiomatic: Chu Ding

sentences.zh: 楚鼎，安豐蒙城人。

translations.literal: Chu Ding was a man of Mengcheng in Anfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Ding was a native of Mengcheng in Anfeng.

sentences.zh: 父㺹，仕金為鎮國上將軍、壽春府防禦使。

translations.literal: His father Bian served the Jin as General of Stabilizing the State and Defense Commissioner of Shouchun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bian had served the Jin as stabilizing-state general and defense commissioner of Shouchun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 金亡，歸宋，命守宿州。

translations.literal: Jin perished; he returned to Song; ordered to guard Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin fell, he returned to the Song and was ordered to hold Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 歲己亥，以州降，阿術魯命㺹守之。

translations.literal: Year jihai; with the prefecture he surrendered; Ashulu ordered Bian to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: In the jihai year he surrendered the prefecture, and Ashulu ordered Bian to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 宋兵來攻宿州，城破，㺹死之。

translations.literal: Song troops came to attack Suzhou; city broken; Bian died for it.
translations.idiomatic: Song forces attacked Suzhou; the city fell, and Bian died in its defense.

sentences.zh: 宋人囚鼎於鎮江府，凡十有四年，會赦免。

translations.literal: Song people imprisoned Ding at Zhenjiang Prefecture; altogether fourteen years; met amnesty and was released.
translations.idiomatic: The Song held Ding prisoner at Zhenjiang Prefecture for fourteen years in all, until an amnesty set him free.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，師渡江，鼎從知太平州孟之縉降。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan twelfth year; army crossed the river; Ding followed Taiping Prefecture prefect Meng Zhijin in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, as the army crossed the Yangzi, Ding followed Taiping prefect Meng Zhijin in submitting.

sentences.zh: 行省遣鼎諭寧國府守將孫世賢，下之，承製授鼎管軍總管，制下，加懷遠大將軍，領兵鎮寧國。

translations.literal: Provincial secretariat sent Ding to persuade Ningguo Prefecture defending general Sun Shixian; he submitted; provisionally appointed Ding military superintendent; after decree issued, added Cherishing-the-Distant Grand General, leading troops to garrison Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: The regional secretariat sent Ding to win over Ningguo's defender Sun Shixian, who surrendered. Ding was provisionally made military superintendent; when the appointment was confirmed he was promoted to Grand General of Cherishing the Distant and stationed at Ningguo with his troops.

sentences.zh: 平建平、南湖、廣德諸盜。

translations.literal: Pacified Jianping, Nanhu, Guangde and other bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified the bandits of Jianping, Nanhu, Guangde, and the surrounding districts.

sentences.zh: 鼎與權萬戶孛羅台護送徽州招撫使李銓男漢英歸徽州，諭銓下其城。

translations.literal: Ding with acting ten-thousand-household Boluotai escorted Huizhou pacification envoy Li Quan's son Hanying back to Huizhou; persuaded Quan to surrender his city.
translations.idiomatic: Ding and acting ten-thousand-household Boluotai escorted Li Quan's son Hanying, the pacification envoy of Huizhou, back to Huizhou and persuaded Quan to surrender the city.

sentences.zh: 十三年，漢英與李世達叛，旌德、太平兩縣附之，鼎與兀忽納進兵，用徽人鄭安之策，按兵而入，兵不血刃而亂定。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year; Hanying and Li Shida rebelled; Jingde and Taiping two counties attached to them; Ding with Uhuna advanced troops; used Huizhou man Zheng An's plan; held troops and entered; troops did not stain blades and disorder was settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Hanying and Li Shida rebelled and the counties of Jingde and Taiping joined them. Ding advanced with Uhuna, followed a stratagem proposed by the Huizhou native Zheng An, and marched in without fighting; the turmoil was quelled without bloodshed.

sentences.zh: 十五年，鼎始受符印。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year; Ding first received tally and seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Ding at last received his seal and tally of office.

sentences.zh: 十八年，東征日本，鼎率千餘人從左丞範文虎渡海，大風忽至，舟壞，鼎挾破舟板漂流三晝夜，至一山，會文虎船，因得達高麗之金州合浦海屯駐，散兵亦漂泛來集，遂領之以歸。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year; eastern expedition against Japan; Ding led more than a thousand men following Left Chancellor Fan Wenhu crossing the sea; great wind suddenly arrived; boats broken; Ding clutched broken boat planks drifting three day-nights; reached a mountain; met Wenhu's boats; thus able to reach Goryeo's Jinzhou Hepu Sea encampment; scattered soldiers also drifted and came to gather; then led them to return.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, on the eastern expedition against Japan, Ding led more than a thousand men under Left Chancellor Fan Wenhu across the sea. A sudden gale wrecked the fleet; Ding clung to broken planking and drifted for three days and nights until he reached an island, where he found Wenhu's ships and made his way to the Goryeo staging camp at Jinzhou on Hepu Bay. Stragglers who had been cast adrift gradually gathered, and he led them home.

sentences.zh: ○樊楫

translations.literal: ○ Fan Ji
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ji

sentences.zh: 樊楫，冠州人。

translations.literal: Fan Ji; Guanzhou native.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ji was a native of Guanzhou.

sentences.zh: 初為軍吏，從參政阿里海牙下鄂、江陵有功，以行省命為都事。

translations.literal: At first a military clerk; followed Administrative Commissioner Alihaiya in taking E and Jiangling with merit; by provincial secretariat order made director.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a military clerk and followed Administrative Commissioner Alihaiya in the conquest of Ezhou and Jiangling. The regional secretariat appointed him director.

sentences.zh: 宋平，從入朝，改員外郎。

translations.literal: Song pacified; followed entering court; changed to outer court section vice director.
translations.idiomatic: After the Song were pacified he went to court and was transferred to the post of outer court vice director.

sentences.zh: 從定廣西，升郎中。

translations.literal: Followed in pacifying Guangxi; promoted to section director.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in pacifying Guangxi and was promoted to section director.

sentences.zh: 從攻崖山，進參議行中書省事、同知湖南宣慰司事。

translations.literal: Followed in attacking Yamen; advanced to counselor of the Branch Secretariat and associate pacification commissioner of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the assault on Yamen and was promoted to counselor of the Branch Secretariat and associate commissioner of the Hunan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，擢僉荊湖占城行中書省事。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year; selected as associate of Jinghu-Champa Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was chosen as an associate administrator of the Jinghu-Champa Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 從阿里海牙徵交趾，無功而還。

translations.literal: Followed Alihaiya in campaigning against Jiaozhi; without achievement and returned.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Alihaiya on a campaign against Jiaozhi that achieved nothing, and they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，复徵交趾，進行中書省參知政事。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year; again campaigned against Jiaozhi; advanced to Branch Secretariat vice administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he campaigned against Jiaozhi again and was promoted to vice administrator of the Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時三道進兵，皇子鎮南王與右丞程鵬飛分二道，一入永平，一入女兒關。

translations.literal: At that time three routes advanced troops; Prince Pacifier of the South and Right Chancellor Cheng Pengfei divided two routes; one entered Yongping; one entered Daughter Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Three columns advanced at once: the Prince Who Pacifies the South and Right Chancellor Cheng Pengfei each led a column, one through Yongping and one through the Daughter Pass.

sentences.zh: 楫與參政烏馬兒將舟師入海，與賊舟遇安邦口，楫擊之，斬首四千餘級，及生擒百餘人，獲船百餘艘、兵仗無算，遂至萬劫山，合鎮南王兵。

translations.literal: Ji with Administrative Commissioner Uma'er led naval forces entering the sea; at Anbang Mouth met rebel boats; Ji struck them; beheaded more than four thousand heads; also captured alive more than a hundred men; obtained more than a hundred boats and arms beyond counting; then reached Wanjie Mountain; united with Pacifier of the South King's troops.
translations.idiomatic: Ji and Administrative Commissioner Uma'er took the fleet to sea. At Anbang Mouth they met the enemy fleet; Ji attacked and took more than four thousand heads, captured over a hundred men alive, and seized more than a hundred ships along with countless weapons. They pressed on to Wanjie Mountain and joined the Prince Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 十二月，進攻交趾，陳日烜棄城走敢喃堡。

translations.literal: Twelfth month; advanced attack on Jiaozhi; Chen Rixuan abandoned the city and fled to Gannan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month they advanced on Jiaozhi; Chen Rixuan abandoned the city and fled to Gannan Fort.

sentences.zh: 二十五年正月，王攻敢喃堡，破之，日烜走入海中。

translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year first month; King attacked Gannan Fort; broke it; Rixuan fled into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-fifth year the prince stormed Gannan Fort and took it; Rixuan fled onto the sea.

sentences.zh: 交人皆匿其粟而逃，張文虎饋餉不至。

translations.literal: Jiaozhi people all hid their grain and fled; Zhang Wenhu's supply convoys did not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jiaozhi hid their grain and fled, and Zhang Wenhu's supply trains never came.

sentences.zh: 二月，天暑，食且盡，於是王命班師。

translations.literal: Second month; heaven hot; food nearly exhausted; thus the King ordered withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: By the second month the heat was fierce and provisions were almost gone, so the prince ordered a withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 楫與烏馬兒將舟師還，為賊邀遮白藤江。

translations.literal: Ji with Uma'er led naval forces returning; was intercepted by rebels at Baiteng River.
translations.idiomatic: Ji and Uma'er were leading the fleet home when the enemy ambushed them on the Baiteng River.

sentences.zh: 潮下，楫舟膠，賊舟大集，矢下如雨，力戰，自卯至酉，楫被創，投水中，賊鉤執毒殺之。

translations.literal: Tide fell; Ji's boats stranded; rebel boats greatly gathered; arrows fell like rain; fought with strength; from mao to you; Ji was wounded; threw himself into water; rebels hooked and seized and poison-killed him.
translations.idiomatic: The tide went out and Ji's ships ran aground. Enemy vessels closed in and arrows fell like rain. He fought from dawn until dusk, was wounded, threw himself into the water, and the rebels hooked him up and killed him with poison.

sentences.zh: 至順元年，贈推忠宣力效節功臣、資德大夫、江浙行省右丞、上黨郡公，諡忠定。

translations.literal: Zhishun first year; posthumously granted Pushing Loyalty and Exerting Strength, Effecting Constancy merit subject; Zide Grand Counselor; Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat right counselor; Shangdang Commandery duke; posthumous title Zhongding.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhishun he was posthumously enfeoffed as a merit subject who pushed loyalty and exerted strength in constancy, granted the title Grand Counselor of Virtue and Right Counselor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, and made Duke of Shangdang Commandery with the posthumous name Zhongding.

sentences.zh: ○張均

translations.literal: ○ Zhang Jun
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun

sentences.zh: 張均，濟南人也。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun; a man of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was a native of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 父山，從軍伐宋，以功為百戶，俄升總把，戰死。

translations.literal: Father Shan; followed army in attacking Song; by merit made hundred-household; soon promoted to company commander; died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shan campaigned against the Song and, for merit, was made a hundred-household officer, soon promoted to company commander, and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 均襲百戶，從親王塔察兒攻鄂州，面中流矢。

translations.literal: Jun inherited hundred-household; followed Prince Tachar in attacking Ezhou; face struck by flowing arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Jun inherited the hundred-household post and followed Prince Tachar in the attack on Ezhou, taking an arrow in the face.

sentences.zh: 中統三年，從征李璮有功，以總帥命升千戶，領兵守淄州。

translations.literal: Zhongtong third year; followed campaign against Li Tan with merit; by marshal's order promoted to thousand-household; led troops guarding Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhongtong he campaigned against Li Tan with distinction, was promoted by the marshal to thousand-household, and garrisoned Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 至元六年，從左丞董文炳攻宋五河口，轉戰濠州北，遇其伏兵，均率眾力戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan sixth year; followed Left Chancellor Dong Wenbing in attacking Song Five Rivers Mouth; turned battle north of Haozhou; met their ambush troops; Jun led the multitude fighting with strength; defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhiyuan he followed Left Chancellor Dong Wenbing against the Song position at Five Rivers Mouth and fought north of Haozhou, where he met a Song ambush; Jun led his men in a hard fight and routed them.

sentences.zh: 十年，攻漣州，奪孫村堡。

translations.literal: Tenth year; attacked Lianzhou; seized Suncun Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he attacked Lianzhou and captured Suncun Fort.

sentences.zh: 十二年，賜金符，授忠翊校尉、沂郯翼千戶。

translations.literal: Twelfth year; granted gold tally; appointed Loyal Assistant Commandant and Yitan Wing thousand-household.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he received a gold tally and was appointed Loyal Assistant Commandant and thousand-household of the Yitan Wing.

sentences.zh: 從攻蕪湖，奪宋戰船，俘四十餘人。

translations.literal: Followed in attacking Wuhu; seized Song war boats; captured more than forty men.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the assault on Wuhu, captured Song warships, and took more than forty prisoners.

sentences.zh: 又從丞相阿塔海戰有功，加武略將軍。

translations.literal: Again followed Chancellor Atahai in battle with merit; added Military Stratagem General.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Chancellor Atahai in battle with merit and was promoted to Military Stratagem General.

sentences.zh: 十四年，賜虎符，加宣武將軍。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year; granted tiger tally; added Proclaiming Martiality General.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he received a tiger tally and was made Proclaiming Martiality General.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，升松江万戶。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year; promoted to Songjiang ten-thousand-household.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was promoted to ten-thousand-household of Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，從鎮南王徵交趾。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year; followed Pacifier of the South King in campaigning against Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he followed the Prince Who Pacifies the South on the campaign against Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，從北征，擢明威將軍、前衛親軍副都指揮使。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year; followed northern expedition; selected Bright Martiality General and deputy commander of the Forward Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he joined the northern expedition and was promoted to Bright Martiality General and deputy commander of the Forward Guard.

sentences.zh: 三十年，世祖親征乃顏，以扈從受賞。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year; Shizu personally campaigned against Nayan; for escort attendance received reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, when Kublai personally campaigned against Nayan, Jun was rewarded for attending him on the march.

sentences.zh: 成宗即位，命屯田和林，規畫備悉有法，諸王藥木忽兒北征，給餉賴之，未嘗乏絕，帝嘉其能，賜予有加。

translations.literal: Chengzong upon enthronement ordered him to farm fields at Karakorum; planning and preparation all had method; when Prince Yimuhu'er campaigned north, supplying provisions relied on him; never lacked or cut off; Emperor praised his ability; gifts and grants were increased.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong took the throne he put Jun in charge of farming at Karakorum. His plans were thorough and sound, and when Prince Yimuhu'er marched north the army's supplies depended on him without a single break. The emperor praised his competence and heaped rewards upon him.

sentences.zh: 大德元年，改和林等處副元帥，歷宣尉司同知，升都元帥，加鎮國上將軍。

translations.literal: Dade first year; changed to Karakorum and other places deputy marshal; passed through Pacification Commission associate commissioner; promoted to grand marshal; added Stabilizing-the-Realm Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dade he became deputy marshal of Karakorum and related posts, served as associate commissioner of a Pacification Commission, was promoted to grand marshal, and received the rank Stabilizing-the-Realm Grand General.

sentences.zh: 延祐元年卒。

translations.literal: Yanyou first year died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Yanyou.

sentences.zh: 子世忠，襲前衛親軍副都指揮使。

translations.literal: Son Shizhong inherited Forward Guard deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shizhong inherited the post of deputy commander of the Forward Guard.

sentences.zh: ○信苴日

translations.literal: ○ Xin Juri
translations.idiomatic: Xin Juri

sentences.zh: 信苴日，僰人也，姓段氏。

translations.literal: Xin Juri; Bo native; surname Duan.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Juri was a man of the Bo people and bore the surname Duan.

sentences.zh: 其先世為大理國王，後累為權臣高氏所廢。

translations.literal: His forebears for generations were kings of Dali; later repeatedly deposed by the powerful minister Gao clan.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestors had been kings of Dali for generations until the powerful Gao clan repeatedly deposed them.

sentences.zh: 歲癸丑，當憲宗朝，世祖奉命南征，誅其臣高祥，以段興智主國事。

translations.literal: Year guichou; in Emperor Xianzong's reign; Shizu received orders for southern campaign; executed his minister Gao Xiang; made Duan Xingzhi preside over state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the guichou year, during the reign of Emperor Xianzong (Möngke), Kublai marched south on imperial orders, executed the minister Gao Xiang, and placed Duan Xingzhi in charge of the realm.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，興智與其季父信苴福入覲，詔賜金符，使歸國。

translations.literal: Yimao; Xingzhi with his youngest uncle Xin Juri Fu entered audience; edict granted gold tally; sent to return to state.
translations.idiomatic: In yimao, Xingzhi and his youngest uncle Xin Juri Fu came to court; they were granted gold tallies and sent home to rule.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，獻地圖，請悉平諸部，併條奏治民立賦之法。

translations.literal: Bingchen; presented maps; requested to pacify all departments entirely; together memorialized methods for governing people and establishing levies.
translations.idiomatic: In bingchen he presented maps of the realm, asked to bring every district under control, and submitted a detailed plan for civil administration and taxation.

sentences.zh: 憲宗大喜，賜興智名摩訶羅嵯，命悉主諸蠻白爨等部，以信苴福領其軍。

translations.literal: Xianzong greatly pleased; granted Xingzhi the name Mahāluocuo; ordered entirely to preside over various Man Bai and Cuan departments; with Xin Juri Fu leading their army.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong was delighted, gave Xingzhi the name Mahāluocuo, put him in charge of the Man, Bai, and Cuan tribes, and placed Xin Juri Fu at the head of their forces.

sentences.zh: 興智遂委國任其弟信苴日，自與信苴福率僰、爨軍二萬為前鋒，導大將兀良合台討平諸郡之未附者，攻降交趾。

translations.literal: Xingzhi then entrusted the state to his younger brother Xin Juri; himself with Xin Juri Fu led Bo and Cuan armies twenty thousand as vanguard; guided great general Uriyangqadai in subduing prefectures not yet attached; attacked and reduced Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhi entrusted the kingdom to his younger brother Xin Juri and, with Xin Juri Fu, led twenty thousand Bo and Cuan troops as the vanguard. They guided the great general Uriyangqadai in bringing the unsubmitted prefectures to heel and forced Jiaozhi to submit.

sentences.zh: 入朝，興智在道上卒。

translations.literal: Entered court; Xingzhi on the road died.
translations.idiomatic: While they were on their way to court, Xingzhi died on the road.

sentences.zh: 中統二年，信苴日入覲，世祖复賜虎符，詔領大理、善闡、威楚、統失、會川、建昌、騰越等城，自各萬戶以下皆受其節制。

translations.literal: Zhongtong second year; Xin Juri entered audience; Shizu again granted tiger tally; edict to lead Dali, Shanchan, Weichu, Tongshi, Huichuan, Jianchang, Tengyue and other cities; from each ten-thousand-household down all received his regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhongtong, Xin Juri came to court; Kublai again granted him a tiger tally and ordered him to oversee Dali, Shanchan, Weichu, Tongshi, Huichuan, Jianchang, Tengyue, and the other garrison cities, with every officer from ten-thousand-household downward under his command.

sentences.zh: 至元元年，舍利畏結威楚、統失、善闡及三十七部諸爨，各殺守將以叛，善闡屯守官不能禦，遣使告急，信苴日率眾進討，大敗之於威楚寶滿裔。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan first year; Sheliwei united Weichu, Tongshi, Shanchan and thirty-seven department various Cuan; each killed defending generals to rebel; Shanchan garrison defending officials could not resist; sent envoy reporting urgent; Xin Juri led multitude advancing to punish; greatly defeated them at Weichu Baoman border.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiyuan, Sheliwei rallied Weichu, Tongshi, Shanchan, and thirty-seven Cuan tribes; each group killed its garrison commander and rose in revolt. The Shanchan garrison could not hold them and sent word for help. Xin Juri marched out and routed them on the border of Weichu's Baoman district.

sentences.zh: 復遣孛羅攻賊於統失城，又大破之，遂定統失。

translations.literal: Again sent Boluo to attack rebels at Tongshi city; again greatly defeated them; then pacified Tongshi.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent Boluo to strike the rebels at Tongshi city, defeated them again, and secured Tongshi.

sentences.zh: 其秋，舍利畏又以眾十萬謀攻大理，詔都元帥也先與信苴日討之。

translations.literal: That autumn; Sheliwei again with multitude one hundred thousand plotted to attack Dali; edict Grand Marshal Yesun with Xin Juri to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Sheliwei gathered a hundred thousand men to strike at Dali. An edict ordered Grand Marshal Yesun and Xin Juri to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 師至安寧，遇舍利畏，擊破走之，遂復善闡，降威楚，定新興，進攻石城、肥膩，皆下之，爨部平。

translations.literal: Army reached Anning; met Sheliwei; struck and broke and drove him; then recovered Shanchan; reduced Weichu; pacified Xinxing; advanced attack on Shicheng, Feini; all taken; Cuan departments pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Anning they met Sheliwei, broke his force, and drove him off. They recovered Shanchan, brought Weichu to terms, pacified Xinxing, and took Shicheng and Feini until the Cuan lands were quiet.

sentences.zh: 三年，信苴日入覲，錄功賜金銀、衣服、鞍勒、兵器。

translations.literal: Third year; Xin Juri entered audience; recorded merit granted gold and silver, clothing, saddle and bridle, weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Xin Juri came to court; his achievements were recorded and he was rewarded with gold and silver, robes, saddle and bridle, and weapons.

sentences.zh: 十一年，賽典赤為雲南行省平章政事，更定諸路名號，以信苴日為大理總管。

translations.literal: Eleventh year; Sayyid Ajall was Yunnan Branch Secretariat pacification commissioner; revised various circuit names; made Xin Juri Dali superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when Sayyid Ajall became pacification commissioner of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat and revised the circuit names, Xin Juri was appointed superintendent of Dali.

sentences.zh: 未幾，舍利畏复叛，信苴日遣石買等詭為商旅，執贄往見，挺矛撞殺之，及其黨一人，梟首於市。

translations.literal: Before long; Sheliwei again rebelled; Xin Juri sent Shi Mai and others falsely as merchants-travelers; holding gifts went to see; thrusting spear struck and killed him; and his party one man; exposed heads at market.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Sheliwei rebelled again. Xin Juri sent Shi Mai and others disguised as merchants, bearing gifts to visit him; they ran him through with a spear and killed one of his followers, then displayed their heads in the market.

sentences.zh: 行省以聞，复賜金一錠及金織紋衣。

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat reported to court; again granted one ingot gold and gold brocade robe.
translations.idiomatic: The regional secretariat reported the deed, and the court again granted him an ingot of gold and a gold brocade robe.

sentences.zh: 於是置郡縣，署守令，行賦役，施政化，與中州等。

translations.literal: Thereupon established commanderies and counties; appointed defending magistrates; carried out levies and corvée; applied civilizing government; equal to central provinces.
translations.idiomatic: He then established commanderies and counties, appointed magistrates, imposed taxes and corvée, and extended civil administration until the region matched the central provinces.

sentences.zh: 十三年，緬國擁象騎數万，掠金齒南甸，欲襲大理，行省遣信苴日與萬戶忽都領騎兵千人御之，信苴日以功授大理蒙化等處宣撫使。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year; Burma state held elephant cavalry tens of thousands; plundered Jinchi and Nandian; wished to raid Dali; Branch Secretariat sent Xin Juri with ten-thousand-household Hudu leading cavalry one thousand to resist; Xin Juri by merit appointed Dali Menghua and other places pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Burma fielded tens of thousands of war elephants, raided Jinchi and Nandian, and aimed to strike Dali. The regional secretariat sent Xin Juri with the ten-thousand-household Hudu and a thousand horsemen to meet them. For this merit Xin Juri was made pacification commissioner of Dali, Menghua, and related districts.

sentences.zh: 十八年，信苴日與其子阿慶復入覲，帝嘉其忠勤，進大理威楚金齒等處宣慰使、都元帥，留阿慶宿衛東宮。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year; Xin Juri with his son Aqing again entered audience; Emperor praised his loyal diligence; advanced to Dali Weichu Jinchi and other places pacification commissioner, grand marshal; retained Aqing to attend Eastern Palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Xin Juri and his son Aqing came to court again. The emperor praised his loyalty and diligence, promoted him to pacification commissioner and grand marshal over Dali, Weichu, Jinchi, and related circuits, and kept Aqing as a guard in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 及陛辭，復拜為雲南諸路行中書省參知政事。

translations.literal: When taking leave at the steps; again appointed Yunnan various circuits Branch Secretariat vice administrator.
translations.idiomatic: As he took his leave from the throne he was again appointed vice administrator of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十九年，詔同右丞拜答兒迎雲南征緬之師，行至金齒，以疾卒。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year; edict together with Right Chancellor Bayandar to welcome Yunnan campaign Burma army; marched to Jinchi; by illness died.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was ordered, together with Right Chancellor Bayandar, to welcome the army returning from the Burma campaign. He reached Jinchi and died of illness.

sentences.zh: 信苴日治大理，凡二十三年。

translations.literal: Xin Juri governed Dali; altogether twenty-three years.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Juri governed Dali for twenty-three years in all.

sentences.zh: 子阿慶襲爵，累授鎮國上將軍，大理金齒等處宣慰使都元帥，佩金虎符。

translations.literal: Son Aqing inherited title; repeatedly appointed Stabilizing-the-Realm Grand General; Dali Jinchi and other places pacification commissioner grand marshal; wore gold tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: His son Aqing inherited his titles, rose to Stabilizing-the-Realm Grand General, and served as grand marshal and pacification commissioner of Dali, Jinchi, and related districts, bearing a gold tiger tally.

sentences.zh: ○王昔剌

translations.literal: ○ Wang Xila
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xila

sentences.zh: 王昔剌，保定人。

translations.literal: Wang Xila; Baoding native.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xila was a native of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 初事世祖，以其有勇略，遂賜名昔剌拔都。

translations.literal: At first served Shizu; because he had courage and stratagem; thus granted the name Sira Badau.
translations.idiomatic: He entered Kublai's service early; for his courage and resourcefulness the emperor gave him the name Sira Badau.

sentences.zh: 從攻釣魚山及阿里不哥，累功賜金符，授武衛親軍千戶。

translations.literal: Followed in attacking Diaoyu Mountain and Ariq Böke; accumulated merit granted gold tally; appointed Martial Guard thousand-household.
translations.idiomatic: He fought at Diaoyu Mountain and against Ariq Böke, earned repeated honors, received a gold tally, and was made a thousand-household of the Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 中統三年，從征李璮於濟南，屢捷。

translations.literal: Zhongtong third year; followed campaign against Li Tan at Jinan; repeatedly victorious.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhongtong he campaigned against Li Tan at Jinan and won repeated victories.

sentences.zh: 四年春，元帥阿術駐兵河南，遣昔剌將蒙古、漢軍復立宿州。

translations.literal: Fourth year spring; Marshal Aju stationed troops Henan; sent Xila to lead Mongol and Han armies to re-establish Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year Marshal Aju was encamped in Henan and sent Xila with Mongol and Han troops to restore Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 至元六年，賜虎符，升海州萬戶。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan sixth year; granted tiger tally; promoted to Haizhou ten-thousand-household.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhiyuan he received a tiger tally and was promoted to ten-thousand-household of Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 引兵攻鹽林山寨，多所俘獲。

translations.literal: Led troops attacking Yanlin mountain stockade; many captures.
translations.idiomatic: He led troops against the Yanlin mountain stockade and took many prisoners.

sentences.zh: 十年，授東川行樞密院同僉。

translations.literal: Tenth year; appointed Eastern Sichuan Branch Privy Council associate commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed associate commissioner of the Eastern Sichuan Branch Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 十五年，徵夔府有功。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year; campaigning against Kuizhou Prefecture with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he campaigned against Kuizhou with merit.

sentences.zh: 十六年，徙鎮萬州，卒於軍。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year; transferred to garrison Wanzhou; died in army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to garrison Wanzhou and died on duty.

sentences.zh: 子二：曰宏，曰寧。

translations.literal: Sons two: named Hong, named Ning.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons: Hong and Ning.

sentences.zh: 宏先佩金符，為左衛千戶。

translations.literal: Hong first wore gold tally; was Left Guard thousand-household.
translations.idiomatic: Hong had already worn a gold tally as a thousand-household of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 及樞密院擬寧襲武職，寧讓其兄宏，於是授宏中衛都指揮使，佩父虎符，而以寧代宏為千戶，佩金符。

translations.literal: When Privy Council planned Ning to inherit martial post; Ning yielded to his elder brother Hong; thus appointed Hong Central Guard commander; wore father's tiger tally; while Ning replaced Hong as thousand-household; wore gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: When the Privy Council proposed that Ning inherit the military post, Ning yielded to his elder brother Hong. Hong was made commander of the Central Guard and wore his father's tiger tally, while Ning took Hong's former post as thousand-household with a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 寧從阿剌台、憨合孫北征，追擊脫脫木兒之軍於阿納禿阿之地。

translations.literal: Ning followed Alatai and Hanhesun on northern expedition; pursued and struck Totoemur's army at Anatua place.
translations.idiomatic: Ning joined Alatai and Hanhesun on the northern campaign and pursued Totoemur's army to the field of Anatua.

sentences.zh: 師還，又從別急裡迷失等擊賊外剌，斬首百餘級。

translations.literal: Army returned; again followed Bieyilimishi and others striking rebels Waila; beheaded more than a hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he again followed Bieyilimishi and others against the rebel Waila and took more than a hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 復從忽魯忽孫北征有功。

translations.literal: Again followed Horhorsun northern expedition with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Horhorsun on another northern expedition with merit.

sentences.zh: 升右衛親軍總管，後改前衛都指揮使司僉事。

translations.literal: Promoted to Right Guard commander-in-chief; later changed to Forward Guard command office associate commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to commander-in-chief of the Right Guard and later made associate commissioner of the Forward Guard command.

sentences.zh: 子處恭襲宏職，仕至侍御史。

translations.literal: Son Chugong inherited Hong's post; served reaching attending censor.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chugong inherited Hong's post and rose to the office of attending censor.

sentences.zh: ○趙宏偉

translations.literal: ○ Zhao Hongwei
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hongwei

sentences.zh: 趙宏偉，字子英，甘陵人，後徙潁川。

translations.literal: Zhao Hongwei; style Ziying; Ganling native; later moved to Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hongwei, style name Ziying, was from Ganling and later moved to Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，國兵攻宋，宏偉以書謁元帥宋都䚟於軍中，奇之，俾以兵略地臨江。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan thirteenth year; national army attacked Song; Hongwei with letter visited Marshal Songdutai in army; marveled at him; made him with troops seize territory Linjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan, as the Yuan armies pressed the Song, Hongwei presented himself in writing to Marshal Songdutai in camp. Songdutai was impressed and sent him with troops to seize territory in Linjiang.

sentences.zh: 至吉州，宋主將管忠節、路分鄒超悉眾出戰，宏偉敗之，追北二十餘里，薄其城，示以禍福，知州周天驥以城降。

translations.literal: Reached Jizhou; Song chief commander Guan Zhongjie, circuit commander Zou Chao all led troops out to battle; Hongwei defeated them; pursued north more than twenty li; pressed their city; showed calamity and blessing; prefect Zhou Tianji with city surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: At Jizhou the Song generals Guan Zhongjie and circuit commander Zou Chao marched out with their full strength; Hongwei defeated them, chased them more than twenty li, and brought his army to the walls. He showed them the consequences of resistance and reward for submission, and prefect Zhou Tianji surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 宋都䚟嘉宏偉有功，賞銀三十兩，署為吉州參佐官。

translations.literal: Songdutai praised Hongwei's merit; rewarded silver thirty taels; appointed as Jizhou assistant official.
translations.idiomatic: Songdutai commended Hongwei's achievement, rewarded him with thirty taels of silver, and appointed him an assistant official in Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 吉民有為亂者，宏偉設伏橋下，以火攻之，賊戰退走，伏發，眾蹂踐幾盡，乘勝搗其巢穴，餘黨悉出拒戰，宏偉旋兵襲其背，斬其渠魁，一州遂安。

translations.literal: Jizhou people had those making disorder; Hongwei set ambush under bridge; with fire attacked them; rebels fought and retreated and fled; ambush issued; multitude trampled almost exhausted; riding victory stormed their nest lair; remaining party all came out resisting battle; Hongwei wheeled troops striking their back; beheaded their ringleader; one prefecture then pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When disorder broke out among the people of Jizhou, Hongwei hid men beneath a bridge and attacked with fire. The rebels broke and fled into the ambush and were nearly trampled to death. He stormed their stronghold, and when the survivors sallied out he wheeled his troops and struck them from behind, beheading their leader, and the prefecture was pacified.

sentences.zh: 宋廂禁軍總管王昌、勇敢軍總管張雲誘新附五營軍為亂。

translations.literal: Song palace guard army commander Wang Chang, Brave Army commander Zhang Yun enticed newly submitted Five Camp army to make disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The Song palace-guard commander Wang Chang and the Brave Army commander Zhang Yun incited the newly submitted troops of the Five Camps to rebel.

sentences.zh: 事覺，昌就擒；

translations.literal: Matter discovered; Chang then captured;
translations.idiomatic: When the plot was discovered, Chang was seized at once;

sentences.zh: 宏偉夜襲雲，斬首以獻，俘其黨五百人。

translations.literal: Hongwei raided Yun by night, beheaded him and presented the head, and captured five hundred of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwei struck Yun by night, took his head as a trophy, and captured five hundred of his followers.

sentences.zh: 宋都䚟欲盡誅之，宏偉曰：「此屬詿誤，非得已也，今悉就誅，何以安反側？」

translations.literal: Song Dutai wished to execute them all. Hongwei said: "These men were deceived and had no choice; if we now kill them all, how can we reassure those who waver?"
translations.idiomatic: Song Dutai wanted to execute them all. Hongwei said, "These men were duped and had no choice. If we kill them all now, how will we reassure those who might still come over?"

sentences.zh: 眾得免死。

translations.literal: The crowd was spared death.
translations.idiomatic: The prisoners were spared.

sentences.zh: 以功授太和縣尹。

translations.literal: For merit he was appointed magistrate of Taihe County.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was made magistrate of Taihe County.

sentences.zh: 宋相文天祥署其將羅開禮、葉良臣，集眾謀复吉、贛、臨江，宏偉斬良臣，俘開禮，釋其餘眾。

translations.literal: Song Chancellor Wen Tianxiang appointed his generals Luo Kaili and Ye Liangchen, who gathered forces to plan the recovery of Ji, Gan, and Linjiang. Hongwei beheaded Liangchen, captured Kaili alive, and released the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Song Chancellor Wen Tianxiang put his generals Luo Kaili and Ye Liangchen in charge of forces plotting to retake Ji, Gan, and Linjiang. Hongwei killed Liangchen, took Kaili prisoner, and released the rest.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以功賜金符，遷瓜州河渡提舉。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, for merit he was granted a gold tally and transferred to superintendent of the Guazhou river crossing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he received a gold tally for his merit and was made superintendent of the Guazhou river crossing.

sentences.zh: 十七年，改衡州路總管府治中。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was reassigned as assistant administrator of the Hengzhou Route Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was made assistant administrator of the Hengzhou route secretariat.

sentences.zh: 群盜出沒其境，宏偉計其地，興屯田，民既足食，盜亦為農，郡遂寧謐。

translations.literal: Bandits came and went within his jurisdiction. Hongwei surveyed the land and opened military colonies. Once the people had enough food, the bandits also turned to farming, and the commandery was tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits roamed his jurisdiction. Hongwei surveyed the land and opened military colonies. When the people had enough to eat, even the bandits took up farming, and the prefecture grew calm.

sentences.zh: 大德五年，用中丞董士恆薦，起僉浙西道肅政廉訪司事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dade, on Vice Censor-in-Chief Dong Shiheng's recommendation, he was summoned and made associate of the Zhexi Circuit Purification and Investigation Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Dade, on Vice Censor-in-Chief Dong Shiheng's recommendation, he was recalled to service as associate of the Zhexi Circuit Purification and Investigation Commission.

sentences.zh: 鎮江旱，蠲民租九萬餘石。

translations.literal: When Zhenjiang suffered drought, he remitted more than ninety thousand shi of rent.
translations.idiomatic: When drought struck Zhenjiang, he remitted more than ninety thousand shi of grain rent.

sentences.zh: 吏畏飛語，复徵於民，民無所出，行台令宏偉核實，卒蠲之。

translations.literal: The clerks feared malicious reports and again collected from the people; the people had no means to pay. The Branch Secretariat ordered Hongwei to verify the accounts, and in the end the collection was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks feared malicious denunciation and tried to collect the rent again, though the people could not pay. The branch secretariat ordered Hongwei to audit the accounts, and the levy was finally cancelled.

sentences.zh: 大風海溢，潤、常、江陰等州廬舍多盪沒，民乏食。

translations.literal: Great winds raised the sea; in Run, Chang, Jiangyin, and other prefectures many houses were swept away and the people lacked food.
translations.idiomatic: Violent winds drove the sea inland; in Run, Chang, Jiangyin, and other prefectures many dwellings were destroyed and the people went hungry.

sentences.zh: 宏偉將發廩以賑，有司以未得報為辭，宏偉曰：「民旦暮飢，擅發有罪，我先坐。」

translations.literal: Hongwei was about to open the granaries for relief, but the officials pleaded that no report had yet arrived. Hongwei said: "The people hunger from morning to night; if opening the stores without authorization is a crime, I will bear it first."
translations.idiomatic: Hongwei prepared to open the granaries for relief, but officials objected that no authorization had arrived. He said, "These people are starving now. If opening the stores without leave is a crime, let the blame fall on me first."

sentences.zh: 遂發之，全活者十餘萬。

translations.literal: He then opened them; more than a hundred thousand were wholly saved.
translations.idiomatic: He opened them anyway, and more than a hundred thousand lives were saved.

sentences.zh: 遷江南行台都事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to director of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to director of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一年，江南大饑，宏偉請以贓罰錢賑之，民賴以生。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, when Jiangnan suffered great famine, Hongwei requested that fines and confiscations be used for relief, and the people relied on this to live.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when Jiangnan was stricken by famine, Hongwei asked that fines and confiscated property be used for relief, and countless people lived because of it.

sentences.zh: 至大二年，召為內台都事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhida he was summoned as director of the Inner Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhida he was summoned to serve as director of the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 仁宗在東宮時，聞其名，遇之甚厚，常以字呼之。

translations.literal: When Renzong was in the Eastern Palace he had heard his name and treated him very generously, often calling him by his style.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong was still heir apparent he had heard of Hongwei and treated him warmly, often addressing him by his style name.

sentences.zh: 及出為浙東廉訪副使，陛辭之日，仁宗出幣帛，俾擇所欲者即賜之。

translations.literal: When he went out as deputy commissioner of the Zhedong Purification and Investigation Office, on the day he took leave at court Renzong brought out silks and cloth and bade him choose what he wished and bestowed it at once.
translations.idiomatic: When he left court as deputy commissioner of the Zhedong Purification and Investigation Office, Renzong presented silks and cloth and told him to take whatever he wanted on the spot.

sentences.zh: 宏偉至浙東，聞郡人許謙得硃熹道學之傳，延致為師，於是人知向慕。

translations.literal: Hongwei reached Zhedong and heard that the prefectural man Xu Qian had received the transmission of Zhu Xi's learning of the Way; he invited him as teacher, and thereafter people knew to look up in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhedong he learned that Xu Qian of the prefecture had inherited Zhu Xi's learning and invited him as his teacher, after which many turned toward the same path.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢江南行台治書侍御史。

translations.literal: Before long he was selected as investigating censor of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was promoted to investigating censor of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年，致仕。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangqing he retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Huangqing he retired from office.

sentences.zh: 延祐三年，復起為福建道肅政廉訪使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yanyou he was again summoned as Purification and Investigation Commissioner of the Fujian Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yanyou he was recalled as purification and investigation commissioner of the Fujian Circuit.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以疾辭。

translations.literal: Before long he resigned on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he resigned for illness.

sentences.zh: 泰定三年卒，年四十四，贈嘉議大夫、禮部尚書、上輕車都尉，追封天水郡侯，諡貞獻。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiding he died, aged forty-four. He was posthumously granted Grand Master for Splendid Discussion, Minister of Rites, and Light Chariot Commandant of the Upper Grade, and enfeoffed as Marquis of Tianshui with the posthumous epithet Zhenxian.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the third year of Taiding at forty-four. Posthumously he was made grand master for splendid discussion and minister of rites, raised to light chariot commandant of the upper grade, and enfeoffed as Marquis of Tianshui with the posthumous name Zhenxian.

sentences.zh: 子思恭，追封天水郡侯。

translations.literal: His son Sigong was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Tianshui.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sigong was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Tianshui.

sentences.zh: 思敬，以處士徵為教授。

translations.literal: Sijing, summoned as a scholar-recluse, was appointed professor.
translations.idiomatic: Sijing, summoned as a scholar in retirement, was appointed a professor.

sentences.zh: 趙璉別有傳。

translations.literal: Zhao Lian has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Lian is treated in a separate biography.
